class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/DepthCameraSensor
class.description: Declares an RGB-D camera through a <mujoco_ros2_plugin> element, mounted on a MuJoCo camera element or on one or two sites, instead of being found by a site prefix.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/LidarSensor
class.description: Declares a GL-rendered lidar through a <mujoco_ros2_plugin> element, mounted on a named site, instead of being found by a site prefix.
